Hey everybody, I'm Dan Mlelen. I'm a scholar of the Bible and religion. And here is Jude verse 5. This is from the updated edition of the New Revised

Now, there are two reasons that this interpretation is probably wrong. One of them has to do with how we interpret who
is being referred to here by Jesus. And the other has to do with textual criticism. Now, the first argument has
to do with the question of whether or not identifying Jesus as the one who brought the people of Israel out of Egypt actually identifies Jesus as the God of Israel. It most likely does not.
